body:
New parser.StringLit: a bare LITERAL (🔤"...") usable directly as a Value, a real, flagged, minimal extension of the source doc's own Value production (which never lists a bare Literal). Emitter: Door STRING works end-to-end (PARENA String -> C char *, no cast needed). Real, checked-not-assumed fix: PARENA's own string reader unescapes \n/\t/\"/\\, but LO's lexQuotedText does zero escape processing, so emitted backslashes must be doubled -- verified live with a real a\b round-trip. Verified end-to-end: DOOR STRING 🔤"hello" compiles+runs+prints hello via the same #define-main driver technique used for FLOAT/DOUBLE. This makes the Arena-threading redesign the only remaining blocker for real MATCH/regex/pcre wiring. 1 new parser test, 2 new e2e emitter tests. 65 tests total, GOWORK=off go build/vet/test ./... clean. commit 6df1df9.

⚓ ☃
title: LO's first real String value (StringLit) + DOOR STRING
